top_signals.title: Canaan’s Q3 revenue plunges 90% to $14.5 million as bitcoin mining hardware sales slump

top_signals.title: Bessent reportedly moved to military base over Iranian threats on his life
top_signals.summary: The move comes as the Department of Justice said late Tuesday that three Iranian nationals have been indicted on terrorism-related charges.

top_signals.title: SoftBank Shares Drop 11% After Booking $7 Billion Loss
top_signals.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. shares dropped as much as 11% after the Japanese tech investor reported its first net loss in almost two years, after a $3.7 billion writedown for its US data-center projects and falling AI valuations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
